status: Prospective protocol before inspection of the forthcoming three scientific gates. Waiting is not a running computation.
question: Does any genuinely distinct source-backed frontier proposal have an unanswered useful comparison supported by accessible authenticated all-EMC measurements and controls, such that one bounded decisive analysis is justified before any new outcomes are inspected?
ownership: Only imprinting/fresh_frontier_value_challenge in retained /workspace/emc-r6-challenge lease; root/Coordinator retains shared state, integration and push authority. No root or shared records edited.
science_window: At most15 minutes after the first immutable new scientific gate is received, ending no later than2026-10-05T20:20:00Z. Source inspection and archival packaging timestamps recorded separately. No extension to find positivity.

fixed_owner_scopes.scope: An actual consequential native MRI/CT/DWI/FDG diagnostic measurement claim. Not FAPI, invented benign-ADC thresholds or a repeat of known myxoid exceptions.
Authentic native functional/metabolic measurement beyond evaluated drug/organoid/PDX questions. Metadata or a platform demonstration alone is not a finding.
Ordinary native biochemical protein measurements beyond previously evaluated ADC/phosphoproteomic rosters; no HLA, glycan or structural content.

source_mask: Frozen compact primary claim/prior-art, methods, assay units, native case/model identity, specimen and all conditions, controls, donor/cohort overlap, public file/schema/capture/access statuses, fixed proposed estimand and usefulness/defeat criteria only. No new per-case gene/protein/functional/imaging endpoint quantities, thresholds fitted from outcomes, matrix rows, images or outcome statistics. Existing exposed R1-R9 decisions remain prior evidence, not cold-hypothesis blinding.

readiness_tests.question: Which primary published claim would this analysis refine or challenge, and what exact public observation was genuinely left unassessed? A new title, source roster, drug name or platform does not establish novelty.
How would either outcome change an EMC researcher’s measurement, comparator, experimental-model choice or belief beyond the prior published result? No invented enrichment or negative paper.

Are all eligible EMC observations plus relevant larger-study cases, contrary conditions and controls retained? Source author labels, molecular authentication and generic/pending labels remain distinct; no shared code or inferred cell class transfers.

Do the actual units, specimen, handling, assay capture, time/treatment and ROI/core/library versus donor units support the proposed estimand? Imaging proxies, protein abundance and actual function are not interchangeable.

Does the frozen proposal offer a discriminating result against batch/mixture/selection/handling, prior art, therapy/site/grade or assay-proxy alternatives? Has its useful conclusion a prospective defeat condition?

Does an actual accessible file/source-linked measured condition and fixed comparator enable one finite decisive stage, with exact all-case scope, uncertainty and both-result decision? Root authorization is still required.

decisions.recommend_one_bounded_stage: At most one specific stage per genuinely worthwhile concrete proposal may be recommended if every material source/value prerequisite is met, the condition/measurement set is fixed before values and either result changes a named scientific decision. No numerical execution here.
decisions.no_go: Name the missing or defeating primary/source/identity/assay/control/value field and preserve every evaluated, unsuitable, inaccessible and pending observation; do not infer all possible analyses exhausted.
decisions.already_answered: Reuse the verified primary result and existing decision, preserving any specific remaining source gap; do not invent another calculation to demonstrate known behavior.
decisions.promotion: NO unless mandatory suitable public evidence and actual scientific-value requirements eventually clear. This review cannot turn source eligibility into a discovery or grant publication.

strongest_common_alternatives: The same useful comparison is already published or verified in R1-R9
Generic sarcoma/model labels, duplicated specimens or donor overlap manufacture apparent EMC evidence
Assay, sampling, mixture, treatment or handling explains the proposed phenotype and current controls cannot discriminate it
Accessible source metadata lack a source-linked numerical measurement/comparator, while missing inputs are mistakenly treated as zero
retained_decisions: GPNMB remains a held narrow exploratory bulk RNA candidate, with high recurrence/secondary-MLPS failure/partial years/unknown overlap preserved; no culture rescue or new GPNMB stage. TMEM266 is shelved. Campaign goal is unmet and search is not exhausted.

constraints.denied_content: FAP tissue, glycan, HLA, structural genomics, fusion-forming/topology scientific content remains denied across routes; no sequence, STR or CNA mechanism bodies. Exact ordinary assay/antigen/library labels only where relevant.
constraints.external: No spend/GPU/private/login/credential discovery/access bypass/unchanged failed-route retry/outreach/publication/PR/manuscript or shared/root write/push. Daily NY06–10 computer-use ban remains; this task uses quiet files only.
constraints.commit: Codex author and committer on owned paths only

verification: Bind every reviewed immutable gate to exact commits, digests and permitted artifact fields. Reuse prior scientific reviews at unchanged hashes; no whole-paper review cycle or redundant numeric replay. Source/hash checks and interpretation/timing limits are separate.
